description.en: Thrinaxodon liorhinus-inspired static reconstruction. Skull and limb references bound the morphology; inferred skin, colour and pose do not establish fur or mammalian anatomy. Revision r002 is a documented origin correction.
description.zh: 三尖叉齿兽 Thrinaxodon liorhinus 启发的静态复原，形态限于颅骨和肢体参考。皮肤、颜色与姿态推断不等于毛被或哺乳动物解剖证据；r002为记录的原点修正。
